profile.summary: Walchandnagar Industries Limited operates as a heavy engineering and project execution company in India and internationally. It operates through Heavy Engineering; Foundry and Machine Shop; and Others segments. The company provides booster motor casings and nozzles for aerospace applications; and design, engineering, manufacture, supply, project management, and supervision services for cement plan
